label: Stable bank identifier
definition: Uppercase normalized bank name

label: Bank name
definition: Bank represented by the annual report

label: Financial year
definition: Year ended 31 December

label: Operational risk management
definition: Explicit operational-risk framework, management or control disclosure
formula_or_coding: 1=explicit disclosure; 0=no explicit disclosure after text screen; blank=unavailable

label: Board/risk committee oversight
definition: Explicit board or committee oversight of operational, cyber, technology or information-security risk

label: Business continuity/disaster recovery
definition: Explicit business continuity, disaster recovery or continuity arrangement

label: Cyber/IT/information security
definition: Explicit cyber, IT, information-security or technology-risk disclosure

label: Internal control framework
definition: Explicit internal-control framework, system or control environment

label: Internal audit/audit assurance
definition: Explicit internal audit, audit assurance or independent control review

label: Compliance/regulatory control
definition: Explicit regulatory compliance, monitoring, AML/CFT, conduct-risk or compliance framework

label: Incident/crisis response
definition: Explicit incident, crisis, disruption or breach-response disclosure

label: Operational Resilience Index
definition: Additive disclosure index
formula_or_coding: SUM(ORI1:ORI8)/8*100; blank if any item unavailable

label: Total directors
definition: Directors serving at year end where identifiable

label: Independent directors
definition: Directors explicitly classified as independent

label: Board independence
definition: Share of directors classified as independent

label: Total assets
definition: Bank-specific year-end total assets

label: Firm size
definition: Natural log of total assets

label: Profit after tax
definition: Bank-specific profit after tax for the year

label: Return on assets
definition: Profit after tax divided by year-end total assets

label: Cash and cash equivalents
definition: Year-end cash and cash equivalents

label: Liquidity control
definition: Cash and cash equivalents divided by total assets

label: Total liabilities
definition: Bank-specific year-end total liabilities

label: Leverage control
definition: Total liabilities divided by total assets

label: Capital adequacy ratio
definition: Bank-specific reported year-end CAR

label: Non-performing loan ratio
definition: Reported NPL ratio, retained for robustness
